recipes.name: One-Pot Lasagna Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and sauté until lightly golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, bouillon, and spices and cook for an additional 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the veggie ground and mushrooms, cooking until much of the moisture from the mushrooms evaporates, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, water, and balsamic vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Then add the lasagna sheets. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until the noodles are al dente.
Stir in the spinach at the very end, and remove the pot from the heat. Garnish and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † This plant-based product has a dry texture and resembles already-cooked ground meat.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
